segments.name: life science segment
segments.description: Develops clinical and preclinical product candidates, primarily nomlabofusp, for patients with rare diseases such as Friedreich's ataxia.
segments.evidence: The Company is managed on a consolidated basis and has one operating and reportable segment related to the development of clinical and preclinical product candidates for the development of the Company's proprietary new therapies, primarily nomlabofusp, the Company's life science segment.
